<!-- Diagnostics: convergence, residuals, jitter, retro, leave-out, profiles. Reads params$model_dir -->

## Diagnostics

```{r}
#| label: gadget-diag-setup
#| include: false
model_dir <- here::here(params$model_dir)
load(file.path(model_dir, "optim/Optimized TMB model fit.rda"))
load(file.path(model_dir, "optim/Optimized TMB parameters.rda"))
opt <- attributes(optim_param)$summary
```

The optimisation `r if (isTRUE(opt$convergence)) "converged" else "did not converge"` after `r opt$gd_calls` gradient calls, with an objective function value of `r round(opt$score, 2)`.

```{r}
#| label: fig-gadget-indices
#| fig-cap: "Observed (points) and modelled (lines) survey indices."
gadgetplots::plot_si(optim_fit)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-gadget-ldist
#| fig-cap: "Length-distribution residuals by fleet."
gadgetplots::plot_resid(optim_fit)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-gadget-retro
#| fig-cap: "Retrospective analysis. Mohn's rho in the caption table."
#| eval: !expr file.exists(file.path(model_dir, "retro/Retro parameters and fit.rda"))
load(file.path(model_dir, "retro/Retro parameters and fit.rda"))
gadgetplots::plot_retro(lapply(retro_list, function(k) k$fit))
```
